description: K.H. Piyadasa v. P.H. Ekanayaka K.H. Piyadasa v. P.H. Ekanayaka View More before Hon. A.W. Abdus Salam, J.
parties: K.H. Piyadasa v. P.H. Ekanayaka K.H. Piyadasa v. P.H. Ekanayaka View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court judgement given in favour of the Respondent, who sued to recover a sum due on a cheque issued by the Appellant for timber, despite the Appellant claiming it was security. Held - Appeal dismissed without costs due to finding of no miscarriage of justice.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
